summary: FIVE target rows, and AFL IS RIGHT ON ALL FIVE: 40, 41, 112, 152 and 154 are FILLER, confirmed with evidence, and none is owed an anchor. THE PREMISE FAILS FIRST, and that is the wave's finding on this series. The task and the context read the disagreement as 'stored filler vs an AFG row that claims MIXED'. On the live animefillerguide page (slug /anime/boruto/, NOT /anime/boruto-naruto-next-generations/, which 404s) the blue class on these five rows is not 'Mixed' at all — every one of them reads '* Anime Canon' with a Chapters cell of 'N/A'. The page's class tally is 171 blue rows, 39 red 'Filler' rows, 114 unclassed rows carrying real chapter numbers, and EXACTLY TWO rows that say Mixed (172 'A Signature of Fear' — '*Mixed, in this episode we watch from minute 18:15 to the end.' — and 177 'The Iron Wall's Sensing System' — '*Mixed, ... from minute 0:00 to 3:43.'), both of which carry an extra `minuto` class. AFG's own prose confirms the taxonomy: 'a 293-episode anime ... with 39 filler episodes, representing 13% of the series' — the 171 blue rows are NOT in AFG's filler count and NOT its mixed bucket; blue on this page is AFG's fourth, story-relevant-anime-original bucket, the same bucket AFL calls 'Anime Canon'. Our lib/afg.ts maps `blue` → 'mixed' unconditionally (afg.ts:119), so all 171 rows enter the catalog as an AFG 'mixed' claim, and the five flags are that mapping, not a source claim. Read correctly, AFL and AFG do not disagree about the manga on these rows at all: AFG prints N/A chapters on every one, and the whole quarrel is a taste difference inside the anime-original space (AFL 40/41 'Filler' vs AFG 'Anime Canon'; and in the OTHER direction on the neighbours — AFL 42 and 155 'Anime Canon' vs AFG red 'Filler'). Under T27 both buckets are FILLER unless an adoption is on record, and none is. THE ACCOUNTING, on three sources beyond the two labels. (1) Narutopedia's SMW `Manga_Chapter` property is a real per-episode chapter map for this franchise, queryable through the api (action=askargs, [[Anime::Boruto]][[Manga Chapter::+]]): 71 Boruto episodes carry it, qualified by a `Manga` value that separates the Naruto space (eps 19-24, 106 → Gaiden chs 700-710) from the Boruto space (eps 1, 39, 53-66, 148-151, 157, 181-220, 287-293 → chs 0-70). NONE of 40, 41, 112, 152, 154 carries the property in either space, and the stored anchors already account for every Boruto chapter 1-67 elsewhere (1-10 → 53-66, 11-15 → 148-151, 16-23 → 181-187, 24-55 → 188-220, 56-67 → 287-293) — nothing is stranded by typing these five filler. (2) TV Tokyo's own per-episode synopses (the licensor; recovered from web.archive.org snapshots of tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/boruto/episodes/index.html at 2018-02-03, 2019-07-31 and 2020-05-06 — the live pages now hold only eps 184-293) describe, for all five, exactly the anime-original content Narutopedia describes and nothing else. (3) Narutopedia's per-character records, which are the sharpest instrument here: EVERY character the two Genin-Mission episodes introduce — Kiri 伎璃, Iori, Tofu, Hidari, Ashimaru — has `Appears_in = Anime` only with `Debut_anime` 760/761 (the franchise-cumulative number: 220 Naruto + 500 Shippuden + Boruto 40/41); Urashiki Ōtsutsuki, whose search drives ep 112's frame, is `Appears_in = Anime, Game` — never Manga; ep 154's Ehō Norimaki and Yuina are `Appears_in = Anime`, `Debut_anime = 874` (= Boruto 154). (4) ja-Wikipedia's episode table is a fourth, negative-but-disciplined leg: it footnotes every arc in the same table that has an outside source or an author's hand (超チョウチョウ蝶モード編 '原作者である岸本斉史が原案を務めた'; 親子の日編 and 湯煙忍法帖編 and サスケ烈伝 'ノベライズ…を原作としてアニメ化'), and it footnotes 下忍編 (eps 40-42) with nothing, and 112 / 152 / 154 with nothing. PER ROW. Eps 40-41 are one two-part anime-original mission (Green Banks; the village head Kiri; the traitor Iori; the mercenaries Hidari and Ashimaru) with zero source segments; the manga's only 'first mission' reference is one recollection panel in ch 1 of Team 7 subduing a BEAR, which is not this mission, and ch 1 is adapted in full by eps 53-54. Ep 112 is two segments: a clip show of the Versus Momoshiki arc's Chūnin Exams and of the anime-original Mitsuki's Disappearance arc (Narutopedia's own Trivia: 'This episode functions as a clip show'; the licensor's framing agrees — 大筒木一族の襲撃による混乱でうやむやになっていた中忍試験の結果の検討), which under the T28 recap clause is WEIGHTLESS and is in any case a DUPLICATE of chapters eps 53-66 own; and a remainder that is entirely anime-original — Sasuke's report on Urashiki (an anime-only Ōtsutsuki) and Shikadai's promotion, which Narutopedia states as anime-only ('In the anime, his talents eventually led to him being the first of his graduating class to become a chūnin'). Remainder original → filler (T27). Ep 152 (Sakura's medical-ninjutsu class; Sarada's crisis of confidence) and ep 154 (Himawari's one-day Academy trial) are single anime-original segments with no source pages. The sole-adaptation exception was not reached on any row: there is no page tie to run it on. WHO LIED: nobody, in the end — animefillerguide's CLASS is an opinion inside the anime-original space and its Chapters column says N/A on all five; the misreading is OURS, in the class→type mapping, and it will keep manufacturing STRONG flags on every Naruto-family page until blue is disambiguated by the row's own note text.

anchor_hostile.why: A1: the row is FILLER and the stored type is confirmed. One segment, the whole episode: Team 7's anime-original first mission to Green Banks (weight: significant to the EPISODE, but zero source share — no numbered Boruto chapter is adapted). Evidence, three legs beyond AFL/AFG: (a) Narutopedia's SMW map carries no `Manga_Chapter` on this page, while the pages that do adapt (148 → 11, 151 → 14/15, 181 → 16 …) carry it — the property is populated for 71 Boruto rows, so the absence is a real negative on a maintained field, not a blank template; (b) TV Tokyo's own synopsis (archived 2018-02-03) is the Green Banks mission end to end — 任務を依頼してきたのはとある村で、内容は、最近たびたび村を襲う盗賊を撃退し二度と近づけないようにすること … 村長だった父を突然亡くし、そのあとを継いだばかりの伎璃（キリ）と … 対面する; (c) every character the episode introduces is anime-only on Narutopedia's per-character records — Kiri (伎璃), Iori and Tofu all read `Appears_in = Anime` with `Debut_anime` 760/761 (franchise-cumulative = Boruto 40/41), i.e. they exist in no manga chapter. Manga cross-check: the only 'first mission' in the source is one recollection panel in ch 1 (Team 7 subdue a bear), a different mission, and ch 1 is adapted by eps 53-54, which hold the anchors. ja-WP's 下忍編 arc header carries no 原作 footnote in a table that footnotes every novel-based and Kishimoto-原案 arc. No annotation is delivered because there is no source segment to annotate.

A1: the row is FILLER and the stored type is confirmed. One segment, the whole episode: the conclusion of the same anime-original Green Banks mission (Iori's confession and death, Kiri's rescue, the genin's fight with Ashimaru while Konohamaru is trapped by Hidari). Zero source share. Evidence: (a) no `Manga_Chapter` on Narutopedia's page while the adapting rows around it carry one; (b) TV Tokyo's synopsis (archived 2018-02-03): 盗賊を装った忍者に伎璃がさらわれた … 第七班は、"盗賊撃退"の任務を"伎璃の救出"に変更 … 敵に木ノ葉丸がとらえられ、伎璃を守りながら、下忍の三人だけで戦わなければならなくなる — no source beat anywhere in it; (c) Hidari and Ashimaru, the episode's antagonists, are `Appears_in = Anime` with `Debut_anime = 760`, so they appear in no chapter of any manga in the franchise. ja-WP's 下忍編 has no 原作 footnote. The sole-adaptation exception is not reached: there is no page tie of any size to run it on. No annotation is delivered because there is no source segment.

A1: the row is FILLER and the stored type is confirmed, under the T28 RECAP CLAUSE. Two segments. Segment 1 — a clip show of the Versus Momoshiki arc's Chūnin Exams and of the anime-original Mitsuki's Disappearance arc, re-shown footage that progresses nothing: weight NIL (a recap counts for nothing in the standing) and, separately, a DUPLICATE — the exam material it re-shows was animated from chs 1-10 by eps 53-66, which hold the anchors, so it could never be a position (A44). Narutopedia's Trivia says it plainly ('This episode functions as a clip show of the events of the Versus Momoshiki Arc and Mitsuki's Disappearance Arc') and the licensor's framing agrees (中忍試験の結果の検討 — a review of results left unresolved). Segment 2, the remainder, which is what decides the type: Naruto and Shikamaru's deliberation, Sasuke's report that he cannot find URASHIKI (an anime-only Ōtsutsuki: Narutopedia `Appears_in = Anime, Game`, no Manga), and Shikadai's promotion to chūnin — which Narutopedia states is an anime event ('In the anime, his talents eventually led to him being the first of his graduating class to become a chūnin, personally selected by the Seventh Hokage himself'), sitting inside its 'In the anime' Steam Ninja Scrolls block. All-original remainder → filler (T27/T28). No sole-adaptation exception: a recap is not a page tie, and its pages are not sole. A `recap` annotation is delivered so the row stays auditable.

A1: the row is FILLER and the stored type is confirmed. One segment, the whole episode: an anime-original medical-ninjutsu course taught by Sakura, sent up as Sarada's crisis of confidence (the coffee-and-milk chakra-control exercise, the Mystical Palm dummies, the flower bud, Shizune's final assignment). Zero source share. Evidence: (a) no `Manga_Chapter` on Narutopedia's page, while ep 151 immediately before it carries `Manga_Chapter = 14, 15` and ep 157 carries 11 — the field is live in this exact stretch, so its absence here is a real negative; (b) TV Tokyo's synopsis (archived 2020-05-06) is the class and nothing else — "医療忍術"の講習会が行われることになり、各班から代表ひとりが講習に参加することになった。第七班からはサラダが参加することになる …; (c) the class's other students are anime-side characters (Hako Kuroi: `Appears_in = Anime, Novel, Game`, no Manga), and the manga's own medical-ninjutsu material for Sarada is later and is not adapted here — no page tie of any size, so no graft, no loose_parallel, and no sole-adaptation question. NOTE for the reader, not a claim of coverage: this is the Boruto shape the task warns about — the anime is AHEAD of the manga here and invents material the manga later assumes; that is anime-original, never adaptation.

A1: the row is FILLER and the stored type is confirmed. One segment, the whole episode: Himawari's one-day Academy trial session (Iruka and Shino's lesson, the obstacle course, the lost-cat mission, her falling-out with Ehō). Zero source share. Evidence: (a) no `Manga_Chapter` on Narutopedia's page; (b) TV Tokyo's synopsis (archived 2020-05-06): ヒマワリが"忍者学校（アカデミー）"の一日体験会に参加することになった … 海苔巻（のりまき）エホウから、興味本位で体験会に参加したことを批判される — the whole episode, no source beat; (c) the two characters the episode is built around besides Himawari, Ehō Norimaki and Yuina, are `Appears_in = Anime` with `Debut_anime = 874` (= Boruto 154), i.e. they exist in no chapter. ja-WP carries no footnote on the row. No source segment, so no annotation and no sole-adaptation question.

annotations.chapters: 1-10 (the Chūnin Exams footage of the Versus Momoshiki arc, as animated in eps 53-66)
annotations.note: weight: NIL (the T28 recap clause) — because the segment is RE-SHOWN footage, not newly animated: Narutopedia's Trivia says the episode 'functions as a clip show of the events of the Versus Momoshiki Arc and Mitsuki's Disappearance Arc', and the licensor's own synopsis frames the episode as a review of the exam results left unresolved by the Ōtsutsuki attack (大筒木一族の襲撃による混乱でうやむやになっていた中忍試験の結果の検討). It progresses nothing, so it counts for nothing in the standing, and the remainder — Naruto and Shikamaru's deliberation, Sasuke's report on the anime-only Urashiki, and Shikadai's promotion, which Narutopedia states happens 'in the anime' — is entirely anime-original, so the row is FILLER. The material is a DUPLICATE, not new: the chapters it re-shows (Boruto chs 1-10, the exams from ch 3 on) are adapted in full by eps 53-66, which carry the anchors — read them there. The chapter range is given as the arc's span because no source states which panels the clips correspond to; the recap ALSO covers the Mitsuki's Disappearance arc (eps 71-92), which is anime-original and has no chapters at all. Weightless and duplicate on both counts, so no anchor (A1 + A44) and the sole-adaptation exception is not reached.

structure.notes: STORED TYPES CONFIRMED ON ALL FIVE — no type_correction, deliberately; AFL is the label that is right, and a confirmation is the result. PREMISE CORRECTION (the wave's headline on this series): the context reads the flag as 'AFG blue = mixed', but on animefillerguide's Boruto page blue is the '* Anime Canon' bucket, not Mixed. Live slug: https://www.animefillerguide.com/anime/boruto/ — /anime/boruto-naruto-next-generations/ is a 404. Class tally over 327 table rows: 171 `blue,blue small` rows, ALL reading '* Anime Canon' with Chapters = N/A; 39 `red,red small` rows reading '* Filler'; 114 unclassed rows carrying real chapter numbers ('1', '1, 2', '8, 9, 10', 'NOVEL', 'Naruto Gaiden: The Road Illuminated by the Full Moon'); and exactly 2 rows whose note says Mixed — 172 'A Signature of Fear' (*Mixed, in this episode we watch from minute 18:15 to the end.) and 177 'The Iron Wall's Sensing System' (*Mixed, ... from minute 0:00 to 3:43.) — both carrying an extra `minuto` class and both with Chapters = N/A. AFG's own prose fixes the taxonomy: 'a 293-episode anime divided into 6 seasons, with 39 filler episodes, representing 13% of the series' — 39 = the red rows exactly, so the 171 blue rows are a FOURTH bucket, not filler and not mixed. lib/afg.ts:119 maps `blue` → 'mixed' with no note check, so all 171 land as an AFG mixed claim; the five STRONG flags in this task are that mapping. A note-aware refinement is available and cheap: the two genuine Mixed rows are exactly the rows whose note text contains 'Mixed' (and they are the only rows carrying `minuto`). ROW IDENTITY (R20): AFL's page has 293 rows, AFG's table has 293 episode rows, our catalog has 293; I joined by TITLE and DATE, not index, and the three agree row for row across the five targets and their neighbours (40 'Team 7: The First Mission!' 2018-01-10; 41 'Strength in Unity' 2018-01-17; 112 'The Chunin Selection Conference' 2019-06-23; 152 "Developing One's Medical Ninjutsu" 2020-04-12; 154 "Himawari's Ninja Trial Session" 2020-04-26 — all identical to the context's stored titles and dates). THE TWO LISTS' REAL DISAGREEMENT is a taste difference inside the anime-original space and it runs in BOTH directions on adjacent rows: AFL 40/41 Filler vs AFG Anime Canon; AFL 42 'A Ninja's Job' and 155 'Mitsuki's Rainy Day' Anime Canon vs AFG red Filler. Neither list claims a chapter on any of them (AFG prints N/A; AFL has no chapter column). Under T27 every row in both buckets is FILLER absent an adoption record, and the series' adoption records (eps 8/9, 67-69, 128-136 author; 221-281 community) do not touch these rows. THE INSTRUMENT WORTH KEEPING: Narutopedia carries a machine-readable per-episode chapter map in Semantic MediaWiki — `action=askargs&conditions=Anime::Boruto|Manga Chapter::+&printouts=Episode number|Manga Chapter|Manga`. It returns 71 Boruto episodes, each with a `Manga` qualifier that separates the two chapter SPACES (eps 19-24 and 106 → Manga=Naruto, chs 700-710, i.e. Naruto Gaiden; everything else → Manga=Boruto, chs 0-70). It reproduces our stored anchors closely (148 → 11, 149 → 12, 150 → 13, 151 → 14/15, 181 → 16 … 293 → 67/68/70) and it does NOT list 40, 41, 112, 152 or 154. Per-character records are queryable the same way (`action=browsebysubject`), giving `Appears_in` and `Debut_anime` as a franchise-cumulative number (220 Naruto + 500 Shippuden + the Boruto number: 760 = Boruto 40, 874 = Boruto 154) — that is how the anime-only status of Kiri / Iori / Tofu / Hidari / Ashimaru / Urashiki / Ehō / Yuina was established. NOT AN INDEPENDENT SOURCE: boruto.fandom.com ('Boruto Wiki', 828 articles, base https://boruto.fandom.com/wiki/Boruto_Wiki, distinct from naruto.fandom.com's Narutopedia at 8,026) exists, but its episode summaries for 40 and 41 are near-verbatim copies of Narutopedia's and its `adaption=` field is empty on every page checked, with 112 and 152 reading 'Summary: TBA' — treat it as ONE lineage with Narutopedia, never a second wiki. LICENSOR: tv-tokyo.co.jp/anime/boruto/episodes/ is alive but now paginates only eps 184-293 (11 pages × 10); the earlier synopses survive in the Wayback Machine on index.html snapshots — 20180203082608 covers eps 34-44, 20190731184657 covers 108-118, 20200506130336 covers 145-154. That is a reusable recipe for the rest of this series.

flags_for_sean: THE PARSER, AGAIN — and this one is not the wave-1 fix. lib/afg.ts:119 reads `blue` as 'mixed' unconditionally, but AFG's blue span carries TWO different labels: '* Anime Canon' (171 rows on this page) and '*Mixed, in this episode we (only) watch from minute X to Y' (2 rows, 172 and 177, which additionally carry a `minuto` class). All five of this task's STRONG flags are the first label mis-read as the second; AFG never claimed a chapter on any of them (Chapters = N/A on all 171). Suggested gate: type = 'mixed' only when the row's note text contains 'Mixed' (or the cell carries `minuto`); a blue row labelled 'Anime Canon' is AFG's fourth bucket and, like AFL's 'Anime Canon', is not a type witness (T27 → filler absent an adoption). This will change the disagreement class on every Naruto-family page and probably on others in the wave-2 list — worth re-running the flag after the change rather than researching more rows of this shape.

AFG's slug for this series is /anime/boruto/ — /anime/boruto-naruto-next-generations/ returns the site's 404 page. If our afg lane derives the slug from the series id, this series' AFG rows may be stale or absent; worth checking how the stored AFG rows for boruto were fetched (they exist, so a mapping presumably already handles it, but the 404 slug is what the obvious guess produces).

OUT OF ASK, same page, the only genuine AFG 'Mixed' rows on this series: 172 'A Signature of Fear' (watch 18:15 → end) and 177 'The Iron Wall's Sensing System' (watch 0:00 → 3:43). Both sit inside the anime-original Kara Actuation stretch (157-180), both print Chapters = N/A, and both are stored filler while AFL calls them 'Anime Canon'. AFG's minute note is a VIEWING guide there, not a source claim, so I expect them to stay filler — but they are the rows a note-aware parser would newly flag, and they were not in this task.

A standing-consistency observation, not a proposal: the context's T6 record still quotes the retired 'AFG's 'Anime Canon' label' type string for eps 221-286, and 57 side_source rows across the catalog carry canon without an adopted record (wave 1's finding, decision 2). Boruto is a large contributor to that set (93-95, 106-111, 282-286). Not touched here.
